title: WGPU Text Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: The text paint and text outline WGPU conformance tests duplicated the same Rgba8Unorm final-render readback helpers already owned by the shared integration-test support module. The duplication made text evidence harder to audit without adding behavior coverage.

repro.summary: Text paint and outline WGPU conformance should render and sample through shared test support while preserving deterministic font setup.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test text_paint_conformance --test text_outline_conformance -j 1

gates.name: text-conformance
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test text_paint_conformance --test text_outline_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named text conformance tests migrated successfully. Remaining conformance families should be handled in separate narrow follow-ons.
